svg.text: KARTOGRAPH · CAPABILITY-CENTRED AI-NATIVE SDL · STATUS v1.6.0
Seven phases. Two planned human–AI sessions.
Every phase is a skill, starts from a fresh context and reads only the files the previous phase wrote. Three runtimes (Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, OpenCode), one source.
Ends when the playback is confirmed.
Record the knowledge, specify the behaviour, show the screens on sample data, plan, then build the real thing – no questions, no review.
Every phase validates or tests its output, commits only its own directories and pushes.
No scheduled meeting. Anything undecided lands in the files as a stub, a collision, an open question or recorded friction.
In voice mode: the AI drives the
app full screen, the person judges.
Only their answer becomes a verdict.
– as a new intent in the next

with real code in every step.

Task N per scenario: steps + code
2 / 3 / 5 / 6 → 1 · Stubs, collisions, open questions and friction (plan or build) are the agenda of the next session 1.
7 → 5 · A failed scenario whose spec still holds is re-planned, then rebuilt; the walk record says what went wrong.
7 → 1 · A failed scenario that reveals a wrong or missing spec becomes a new intent (related: the old one); phases 2 to 7 run again.
NOT BUILT YET · AND ONE DEFAULT TO REPLACE
Verify, deliver and observe from the nine-phase blueprint have no skill yet. The build's
server section is Kartograph's own minimal Ktor default: the knowledge repo's server and
shared-core atoms are deferred, and it will be replaced the day they land.
GUARDRAILS THAT HOLD IN EVERY PHASE
Never invent: what was not said becomes an assumption, an open question, a stub or friction.
Every phase writes and commits only its own directories. No “verified”, no “accepted” by the AI.
Test first, never a weakened test, never a fake in production. Vocabulary from knowledge/.
Human only when a decision is needed, later
End-to-end linkage: intent file → sources / # Source intent → capability.md → feature-<capability>/ → plans/ → (+ core/, server/) → walks/. Status: Kartograph v1.6.0, 2026-09-16.
Skills: explore (interactive) · knowledge · features · views · plan · build (fully automated) · walk (interactive, once per scenario) – Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT and OpenCode from one source.
